correctness.rationale: Coupled iid exponential clocks yield the process. A symmetrization/Doob bound makes the diffuse component uniformly deterministic, while the finite heavy components converge uniformly. Positive diffuse drift and zero probability of exact-threshold jumps justify passage-time convergence. Conditioning on the active finite subset yields exact strict-survival and atomic masses; binary subset weights attain \(2^r\) distinct atoms. Marked Poisson optional stopping gives the discrete-time limit in mean square, and exponential missing-weight tails yield all positive moments. A standalone exact finite checker passed 2,063 assertions; it is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The coexistence of macroscopic and diffuse coupon weights is a mathematically motivated transition case between the two published extreme regimes. Its exact survival law and sharp \(2^r\) discrete atom count determine a previously uncharacterized distributional feature; the atomless finite / atomic limit obstruction explains why stronger distributional convergence fails despite all moment convergence.
